titulo: Accused in Tupac Shakur murder trial says nephew fired the fatal shots in 1996 drive-by shooting
cuerpo: Jurors on Thursday heard Duane (Keffe D) Davis tell detectives in an audio recording of a 2008 police interview that his nephew Orlando (Baby Lane) Anderson fired the shots that killed rapper Tupac Shakur. Davis is accused of orchestrating the 1996 killing of the 25-year-old hip-hop superstar.
